name: rtl-ai-chats
description: Automatic right-to-left (RTL) text support for AI coding assistant chat panels (Claude Code, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini Code Assist, Copilot Chat, and Antigravity's built-in agent) across VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin Desktop, and Antigravity. Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or Microsoft.

commands.title: RTL: Re-inject into All AI Agents

rtl-ai-chats.enabled.markdownDescription: Turn RTL support **on or off** across every patched editor and chat. (Turning this off restores the original, unpatched files.)

rtl-ai-chats.autoApplyOnStartup.markdownDescription: Re-apply automatically on startup and after updates — needed because editor/extension updates overwrite the patch.

rtl-ai-chats.showInActivityBar.description: Show the RTL for AI Chats panel (icon) in the left Activity Bar.

rtl-ai-chats.showStatusBar.description: Show the small RTL on/off item in the status bar.

rtl-ai-chats.font.family.description: Font used for right-to-left text. Vazirmatn and Sahel are bundled and work out of the box; System default uses whatever the chat already renders with.

rtl-ai-chats.font.scale.description: Size of RTL text relative to the chat's default (1 = 100%).

enumDescriptions: Smart: an element goes RTL once enough of its letters are RTL (best for text full of English terms).
Use the first strong character, like the browser's native dir="auto".
rtl-ai-chats.detection.mode.description: How the direction of each chat message is decided.

rtl-ai-chats.detection.threshold.markdownDescription: Smart mode only: minimum share of RTL letters (0.1–0.7) for a message to become RTL. Lower = flips more easily.

rtl-ai-chats.applyToInput.description: Also flip the message box to RTL as you type.

rtl-ai-chats.showMessageToggles.description: Show a small toggle on each message to override its direction by hand.

rtl-ai-chats.keepCodeLeftToRight.description: Keep code blocks, diffs and terminals left-to-right.
